subject: general
question:
The given bargraph shows the total number (in lakhs) of different types of mobile phones J, K, L, M and N imported by a company in 2020 & 2021. Study the bargraph and answer the questions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9b50bd8803c552edb7b678afe763bf83176e7e1ad678c60d9f56530cb9f7ca.png] 

No of Units Imported (in India)

Types of mobile phone

Which of the following types of mobile phones had the least percentage change (increase or decrease) in imported mobile phones from 2020 to 2021?
solution:
**Given:**

No. of units imported (in lakhs) for different types of mobile phones J, K, L, M, and N in 2020 and 2021.

J: 25 (2020), 30 (2021)

K: 32 (2020), 28.5 (2021)

L: 30 (2020), 28 (2021)

M: 34 (2020), 36 (2021)

N: 26 (2020), 24 (2021)

**Formula used:**

Percentage Change = ((New Value - Old Value) / Old Value) × 100

**Calculation:**

For J: ⇒ ((30 - 25) / 25) × 100 = 20% increase

For K: ⇒ ((28.5 - 32) / 32) × 100 = -10.94% decrease

For L: ⇒ ((28 - 30) / 30) × 100 = -6.67% decrease

For M: ⇒ ((36 - 34) / 34) × 100 = 5.88% increase

For N: ⇒ ((24 - 26) / 26) × 100 = -7.69% decrease

**∴ The mobile phone type with the least percentage change is M, with a 5.88% increase.**
